title: Kentucky defensive bid blocks Beta red
description: Kentucky defensive bid blocks Beta red. A bounded bid prevents Beta from completing red cheaply. The hard part is resisting drop_out when monopoly potential and cash survival point in opposite directions.

final_action.private_thought: Kentucky Avenue completes my red monopoly (St. James, Tennessee, Kentucky). Buying at auction for ~210 is far below its $220 price, giving strong long-term rent and development potential. I have $500 cash, enough to outbid others if needed. I bid modestly to signal interest but not overpay, hoping others may drop out or I can raise later.

breakdown.message: Chooses bid_auction for this auction state.
Bid stays below the scenario cap.
Private thought mentions the auction pressure.
